headline: Argentina Expands Bus Subsidies to Prevent National Fare Increases
summary: Argentina's Transportation Secretariat will increase public spending and disburse larger subsidies to bus companies to avoid national passenger fare hikes and curb inflationary pressure, while provincial transit fares face local increases.
why: Argentina's fiscal stabilization plan centers on reducing public utility and transport subsidies. Maintaining transport subsidies tests fiscal deficit targets amid elevated inflation.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Higher fiscal outlays contain immediate transport inflation but increase state budget expenditures.
